indicators.name: BIP-110 / Governance Status

trend.detail: Zero miner signaling across all 30 daily samples since lock-in. UASF mechanism: lock-in is height-based (963648), not signaling-dependent.
trend.enforcement_state: ACTIVE — BIP-110 rules enforced at height >= 963648
trend.miner_compliance: 0% voluntary signaling (not required — UASF height trigger)

confidence.reason: Verified from primary on-chain source (mempool.space public API). Lock-in at height 963648 confirmed. All 10 recent blocks show bit4=false. Zero signaling for 30 consecutive days.
confidence.caveat: Signaling is voluntary post-lock-in; enforcement is by node policy, not miner consensus.

missing: Node-level enforcement rate (% of nodes actually enforcing)
